_comment: Copy this file to auth.json (gitignored) and fill in real domains. Each key is a domain from seed.txt. Only reference environment VARIABLE NAMES here - never put actual passwords/tokens in this file. Set the real values in your shell or a local, gitignored .env before running `scrapy crawl`.

already-logged-in.example.com._comment: storage_state: reuse an existing session (cookies + localStorage) instead of logging in at all. Export it once from a real browser (or from a prior playwright_login run's save_storage_state) and point here.

plain-form-login.example.com._comment: form_login: a normal <form method=post> login, no JS needed. Field names must match the <input name=...> attributes on the login page.

spa-login.example.com._comment: playwright_login: a JS-rendered login form (React/SPA). Selectors are CSS selectors on the login page/post-login page. save_storage_state (optional) persists the session so future runs can skip straight to storage_state instead of logging in again.

api.example.com._comment: api_token: injects a header on every request to this domain - no login flow at all.
